items.name: Blodstorkenebb
items.observations: Bushy branching perennial with reddish hairy stems, several individual magenta-purple five-petaled flowers with visible veins, deep palmate green leaves with about five to seven narrow divisions, buds and fibrous roots. Leaves and flowers match broad diagnostic field characters.
items.limitations: Petals and stamens are somewhat stylized, and some flowers appear larger relative to the leaves than typical plants. Illustration is a visual identification aid only; compare living plants and verified photographs before species identification.
